capabilities_done: (1) extension_exactness declares ExtOperator::ExtendedEnvelope(op) for every op pigment defines except content-aware fill (render-gpu runs no content-aware fill at all): linear exposure, layer effects, gaussian blur, unsharp mask, median, layer blur, backdrop blur, transform

flags: Params.flags bit 2 (EXTENDED_FLAG) now also on the adjustment-layer and effect-colour composites; BlurP.ext (was pad0); FilterP.op bit 8 (FILTER_EXTENDED_BIT); ResampleParams.ext (was pad0); unit plans write 0 there, so every unit dispatch reads the same parameters as before

WGSL in extended mode: exposure_ch and adjust_apply drop their clamps and the adjustment lerp is unclamped (pigment apply_in / composite_adjustment_in); blur/filter unpremul keep P/A unclamped (unpremultiply_in); unsharp combine unclamped (filter_window_in); resample keeps P/A unclamped (sample_rgba_in); effect mattes are alpha maths (unchanged), the effect colour and content composite through the extended kernel

overflow: every extended pass turns a marked input (alpha > 1.5, the alpha-2 marker) or a non-finite input or result (exponent-bit test) into the marker; the composite kernel marks any marked or non-finite source; the read-back refuses a marked texel (threshold now alpha > 1.5) as Unsupported{sample_range_outside_unit}

(2) shared-texture path: the output pass (binding 3, atomic<u32> flag) skips a marked or non-finite texel of an extended plan and sets the flag; render_to_texture clears the flag per execution and run reads it once after the last chunk (4 bytes, extended plans only, counted in GpuStats.bytes_read_back) and returns Unsupported{sample_range_outside_unit}, the error render-cpu returns; unit plans write every texel exactly as before and read nothing
